# Spice Professors

> > Premium artisanal spice blends, gourmet teas, and handcrafted seasonings from New York City's finest spice specialists.

Spice Professors has been crafting small-batch, kosher-certified spice blends and gourmet teas since 2007, with retail locations across NYC including the Grand Bazaar. The company specializes in salt-free, gluten-free seasonings featuring both classic blends and globally-inspired flavors.
